camera.motion: static (background phase-correlation shift < 0.2 px over all frames; tracks/camera_shift.csv)

intrinsics_from_benchmark_convention.note: Orbbec Femto Mega, HFOV 80 deg, f = 0.5959 * 1280; not measured from this video

camera.image_artifacts: background outside person and ball is artificially blurred (SAM2 demo 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' watermark bottom-right, x~1035-1275,y~698-714); face blurred/greyed; rows y>=~712 are a bright encoding strip, treat y~711 as the effective bottom edge

perspective.description: camera looks into a room corner, roughly level, slightly downward; floor occupies y>~480
perspective.horizon_note: floor lines of two perpendicular walls; horizon not directly visible; both floor lines slope down away from the corner so the camera is above floor level looking slightly down. Values read by eye from a gridded frame (+-5 px), background blurred.

objects.name: ball
objects.desc: large grey/purple-grey exercise (gym) ball, matte with specular highlights; the only rolling object
objects.visible_frames: 0-46 (46 only a sliver at bottom-left; fully gone 47-48)
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centre of circle fitted to the mask outline (visible centre of the sphere); use cx_fixedR,cy_fixedR for frames >=38 where the bottom is cut off

static_phase.note: held by the person's hands, upper-left/right rim partly covered by hands/forearms

objects.apparent_size_change: diameter 113.9 px (frames 0-13) -> 140 (21) -> 164 (26) -> 185 (29) -> 204 (32) -> ~248 (36) -> ~275-290 (38) -> ~310-330 (40); 1/diameter is close to linear in frame for 17-33 (ball approaching camera)

objects.name: person
objects.desc: person (long dark hair, black top and black trousers, white sneakers, face blurred) squatting against the back wall in the corner, behind the ball; pushes the ball toward the camera then raises the arms
objects.moves: body stays in place (squatting); arms move
objects.track: tracks/person.csv (dark clothing+hair mask; excludes bare forearms/hands and white shoes)

full_extent_frame45_px.note: squatting height incl. shoes, by eye on a 3x zoomed grid, +-3 px
